summary: Post deploy-blocker + security-refactor regression PASS. All 8 requested regression checks green: (1) Admin login POST /api/auth/login with admin@padelappretas.com/admin123 -> 200 + valid JWT (access_token, refresh_token, expires_in=900). (2) Backend boots clean on sentry-sdk==2.20.0, `import sentry_sdk` -> version 2.20.0, no ImportError; GET /api/ -> 200 {status:ok}. (3) seed_admin_if_needed(hash_password) on populated DB returns False (idempotent) and ADMIN_EMAIL_DEFAULT/PASSWORD are read from env (not hardcoded). (4) Old credential-disclosing log line ('Admin seedeado (admin@padelappretas.com / admin123)') is GONE from server.py source; only a historical 2026-05-27 log entry remains — current boot emits the sanitized 'Admin inicial seedeado desde ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_EMAIL' path (only when seed actually runs). (5) pytest suite iter50 (10) + iter51 unit (18) + iter51 http (21) = 49/49 PASS in 3.48s. (6) Frontend /localhost:3000/ served HTML contains the google-site-verification meta with content=Aqzz6Phf6_t49Gk9Iql8aSCLA_g8RX_6b2GNSPBrK94. (7) app.config.js evaluates cleanly via require() and correctly strips android.googleServicesFile when the real file is missing (only google-services.json.TODO present). (8) wellknown endpoints: GET /.well-known/apple-app-site-association -> 200 JSON with AASA payload using IOS_TEAM_ID from env; GET /.well-known/assetlinks.json -> 200 JSON with ANDROID_SHA256_FINGERPRINTS from env. Security refactor is fully transparent — no functional regression detected.

minor.issue: Benign passlib+bcrypt AttributeError trace on startup (bcrypt.__about__ missing) from passlib 1.7.4 vs bcrypt 4.1.3. Non-blocking; hashing still works (login PASS). Pre-existing warning, not caused by this refactor.

action_items: No blockers. Deploy pipeline should be unblocked from the code side — user can re-attempt deploy via Emergent UI.
OPTIONAL: silence the passlib bcrypt.__about__ AttributeError by pinning bcrypt<4 or upgrading passlib>=1.7.5. Currently benign but noisy in logs.
REMINDER: before exposing padelappretas.emergent.host publicly, rotate ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD in backend/.env to a strong value (current admin123 is dev-only).
critical_code_review_comments: core/db.py — seed_admin_if_needed now correctly gates on env presence: returns False + warning log if either ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_EMAIL or ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD is missing. Uses os.getenv with empty-string default (falsy) so a missing env is unambiguous. Good.
server.py — new bootstrap log 'Admin inicial seedeado desde ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_EMAIL' contains no credentials. Only prints when seeded=True.
backend/.env — ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_EMAIL/PASSWORD present (dev values) with clear comment about rotating in production. Correct.
requirements.txt — sentry-sdk==2.20.0 pinned and importable; sentry_sdk.init runs successfully via SENTRY_DSN env.
frontend/app/+html.tsx — google-site-verification meta correctly wired and served in the Expo Web SSR HTML output at localhost:3000.
frontend/app.config.js — small, focused, guards on fs.existsSync; verified via `node -e require()` that the exported expo.android object has NO googleServicesFile key when only .TODO exists.
routers/wellknown.py — dynamic env-driven, .strip() on IOS_TEAM_ID, comma-split + empty-filter for fingerprints; startup warnings fire when placeholders detected.

success_rate.backend: 100% (49/49 pytest cases + all 8 regression bullet checks passed)
